evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: you'll own a growing share of the testing, data contracts, and observability that let the rest of the business rely on our data with confidence
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (testing, data contracts, observability, trust infrastructure, data quality) dominate throughout despite 'move faster' language tied specifically to AI-assisted coding rather than overall delivery pace.
evidence.domain_risk: Experience in the insurance sector is a plus. As more of the routine coding becomes AI-assisted, domain understanding becomes more valuable, not less
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Zego operates in motor insurance which touches financial/regulatory territory, but the JD itself has no explicit compliance or regulatory-reporting language, keeping it at moderate rather than high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: We're a small, dynamic team responsible for all aspects of data — availability, quality, integration, problem formulation, success metrics, reporting, and analytics
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools in responsibilities (dbt, Snowflake, Looker) and an established AI-first workflow show an existing, growing data function, but the team is explicitly described as small, so mid rather than mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create secure, efficient data shares for external partners (e.g. S3, SFTP, Snowflake Data Sharing)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools, specific data sources (Amplitude, Segment, Google Ads), and concrete mechanisms (S3, SFTP, Snowflake Data Sharing), clearly written by someone who knows the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: We're a small, dynamic team responsible for all aspects of data — availability, quality, integration, problem formulation, success metrics, reporting, and analytics
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary framing is around the data platform and trust infrastructure itself, serving the business broadly rather than any single named commercial/product/finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: you'll design and build data models with the support of AI-assisted workflows, and you'll own a growing share of the testing, data contracts, and observability
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines growing ownership of trust infrastructure (strategic) with execution work building models under senior engineer guidance, appropriate for a 1-3 year experience level.
evidence.ai_role: already using (or quickly building confidence with) AI tools to work smarter, and taking ownership of staying ahead. This is central to how our team works, not a nice-to-have
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is explicitly expected to use AI coding tools to accelerate their own SQL/data-modelling work, a textbook ai_user signal reinforced throughout the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Help build and maintain the "trust infrastructure" — tests, data contracts, and observability — that lets the business depend on our models
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing, data contracts, and observability are framed as an owned responsibility ('own a growing share of') rather than a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure quality, reliability, and stability across data models and pipelines
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: the JD repeatedly emphasizes trust, correctness, and reliability of data models but frames this as operational/engineering trust rather than compliance or regulatory risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data platform, tooling, and ways of working — including how we use AI in our workflows
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes building new AI-assisted workflows and trust infrastructure with maintaining and improving existing data models and pipelines, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: We call it Zego Hybrid. While some of our team choose to come into our central London office once a week, we're flexible - some people prefer being in once a month or even quarterly.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure quality, reliability, and stability across data models and pipelines — reflects concern for data/model trustworthiness rather than regulatory or compliance risk.
